name: morning_briefing
description: Runs automatically every morning at 8am to give a full daily briefing: today's weather, unread Gmail, today's Google Calendar events, and daily anime news. Also usable on request ("give me my morning briefing", "what's on my plate today").
instructions: Give a single spoken briefing covering four things, in this order: (0) Weather: call the weather tool (no place, days 1) and give today's conditions, high/low and rain chance in one sentence. (1) Unread Gmail — use the mcp_gmail tools to check the inbox for unread messages; report roughly how many there are and call out sender + subject for anything that looks important or time-sensitive, skipping routine newsletters/promos unless asked. (2) Today's calendar — use the mcp_calendar tools to list today's events on the user's Google Calendar; report each event's time and title in chronological order, or say the day is clear if there's nothing on it. (3) Daily anime news — use web_search for today's anime news (new episode releases, announcements, simulcast schedule) and summarize the 2-4 most relevant headlines. If the Gmail or Calendar tools aren't available (server not connected/authenticated), skip that section, mention briefly that it couldn't be checked, and continue with the rest rather than failing the whole briefing. Keep the whole thing tight and conversational since it's spoken aloud, not read. When this runs automatically at 8:00 AM (a scheduled run, not an on-request one), also call write_file to save the full text of the briefing to C:\Users\USER\OneDrive\Documents\01_Projects\Jarvis_Workspace\Notes\morning_briefing_YYYY-MM-DD.txt (today's date), before giving the spoken briefing. If the save fails, mention it in one short sentence and still give the briefing.
